2026-09-30-does-a-stop-where-the-page-st.verdict: A restraint block has no measurable effect on judged invention (risk stratum 18.3% to 21.1%, p 0.80, floor 2.8 pp), though it cuts unmarked open ends 22.5% to 8.5%.

2026-09-30-leaf-identity-is-the-page-ima.verdict: The shown image is a different leaf from the translated text on 6 of 298 decidable pages (2.0%), all Internet Archive (3.8% of IA pages); the image is right, the Gemini OCR text is shifted.

2026-09-30-lite-vs-flash-on-the-same-pag.verdict: On the same pages flash invents more (15.8% vs 8.2%/9.2% for two lite runs); fidelity >= 4 and omission do not differ measurably. Rule output: lite stays.

2026-09-30-mineru-on-the-english-referen.verdict: MinerU is neither peer nor tier-3 fallback, narrowly: catastrophic 2.6% (bar 2%), refused-page pooled CER 2.25x lite (bar 2x), mostly from dropped footnotes; median delta +0.19 pp.

2026-09-30-ndl-classical-ocr-lane-20-boo.verdict: On 20 cursive Japanese books NDL and stored Gemini readings barely agree (median Dice 0.067); by eye NDL gives the page's text on 9/10 pages, Gemini was invented or looping on 3 of 4.

2026-09-30-syriac-per-stratum-preprocess.verdict: The #5250 Syriac preprocessing gains do not transfer to library pages: the classifier finds 0/6 dark pages and routed auto vs production is +0.7% letters read, p 0.26.
2026-09-30-syriac-per-stratum-preprocess.decision: Preprocess flag ships OFF (--preprocess none); no re-read; #4883 re-translation proceeds on existing reads

2026-09-30-why-is-gemini-ocr-off-leaf-on.verdict: Off-leaf IA OCR is text stranded by the #3368 image repair: 399 books, 105,316 translated pages flagged needs_reocr that nothing reads; matches 27 of 29 detector books.
